stages.prompt:
Humans once played Pong for fun. You will build it so I can watch you struggle. Your program runs as a loop. Each tick, read one input line (it may be empty; ignore it for now) and print one frame: exactly 20 rows of exactly 20 characters, then a line containing only ---. Use . for an empty cell and draw exactly one ball as O, anywhere on the board. Keep looping until the input ends.

Example 1 input:

Example 1 output:
....................
....................
....................

....................
.........O..........
....................
....................

....................
....................
....................
....................
....................
---

A ball with no paddles is a screensaver. Add two paddles. Each paddle is 3 | characters stacked in one column: the left paddle in column 0 and the right paddle in column 19 (rows and columns count from 0). Start them on any rows you like. The input line now holds the keys pressed this tick, possibly several or none: q moves the left paddle up one row, a moves it down, p moves the right paddle up, and l moves it down. A paddle stops at the top and bottom edges and never leaves the board. Keep exactly one ball O on the board, never in column 0 or 19; it may stay still. Each frame is still 20 rows of 20 characters followed by ---.

Example 1 input:
q
Example 1 output:

|...................
|..................|

stages.check_script:
PADDLE = 3
LOWEST_TOP = 20 - PADDLE


def paddle_top(game, rows, column, side):
    cells = [row_index for row_index, row in enumerate(rows) if row[column] == "|"]
    game.check(
        len(cells) == PADDLE and cells[-1] - cells[0] == PADDLE - 1,
        f"The {side} paddle must be 3 | characters stacked in column {column}.",
    )
    return cells[0]


def read_board(game, keys):
    rows = game.tick(keys).rows
    game.check(
        len(rows) == 20 and all(len(row) == 20 for row in rows),
        "The board must be 20 rows of 20 characters.",
    )
    game.check(
        all(cell in ".O|" for row in rows for cell in row),
        "The board may only use ., O, and |.",
    )
    game.check(
        all("|" not in row[1:19] for row in rows),
        "Paddles must stay in column 0 and column 19.",
    )
    balls = [row[1:19].count("O") for row in rows]
    game.check(
        sum(balls) == 1 and all(row[0] != "O" and row[19] != "O" for row in rows),
        "The board must show exactly one ball (O), never in a paddle column.",
    )
    return paddle_top(game, rows, 0, "left"), paddle_top(game, rows, 19, "right")


def moved(top, step):
    return min(LOWEST_TOP, max(0, top + step))


def check(game):
    left, right = read_board(game, "")
    presses = [
        ("q", -1, 0, "Pressing q must move only the left paddle up one row."),
        ("a", 1, 0, "Pressing a must move only the left paddle down one row."),
        ("p", 0, -1, "Pressing p must move only the right paddle up one row."),
        ("l", 0, 1, "Pressing l must move only the right paddle down one row."),
        ("ql", -1, 1, "Pressing q and l together must move both paddles."),
        ("", 0, 0, "With no keys pressed, the paddles must stay still."),
    ]
    for keys, left_step, right_step, rule in presses:
        new_left, new_right = read_board(game, keys)
        expected = (moved(left, left_step), moved(right, right_step))
        game.check((new_left, new_right) == expected, rule)
        left, right = new_left, new_right
    for keys, left_step, right_step in [("q", -1, 0), ("a", 1, 0), ("p", 0, -1), ("l", 0, 1)]:
        for _ in range(20):
            new_left, new_right = read_board(game, keys)
            expected = (moved(left, left_step), moved(right, right_step))
            game.check(
                (new_left, new_right) == expected,
                f"Holding {keys} must move the paddle until it stops at the edge.",
            )
            left, right = new_left, new_right

stages.prompt:
Now make it a game, if you can. Each tick, move the paddles first, then the ball. The ball moves exactly one row up or down and a fixed number of columns left or right: pick 1 to 4 columns and keep that speed for the whole game. If the next row would leave the board, the ball first turns around vertically, then moves. If the next column would be 0, 19, or beyond, look at that side's paddle: if it covers the row the ball is moving into, the ball first turns around horizontally, then moves; if not, it is a miss, the other side scores one point, and you serve the ball again from any row and any column from 5 to 14, in any direction. The ball is never drawn in column 0 or 19. After the 20 board rows, print a score line with the left and right points separated by one space, starting at 0 0, then ---. Where the ball starts, how fast it moves sideways, and which way you serve it are up to you.

stages.reference_solution:
import sys

PADDLE = 3
left = 8
right = 8
ball_row = 9
ball_col = 9
step_row = 1
step_col = 1
scores = [0, 0]

for line in sys.stdin:
    keys = line.strip()
    if "q" in keys:
        left = max(0, left - 1)
    if "a" in keys:
        left = min(20 - PADDLE, left + 1)
    if "p" in keys:
        right = max(0, right - 1)
    if "l" in keys:
        right = min(20 - PADDLE, right + 1)

    if not 0 <= ball_row + step_row <= 19:
        step_row = -step_row
    ball_row += step_row
    next_col = ball_col + step_col
    if next_col <= 0 or next_col >= 19:
        paddle = left if next_col <= 0 else right
        if paddle <= ball_row < paddle + PADDLE:
            step_col = -step_col
            next_col = ball_col + step_col
        else:
            scores[1 if next_col <= 0 else 0] += 1
            ball_row, next_col = 9, 9
            step_col = -step_col
    ball_col = next_col

    for row in range(20):
        cells = ["."] * 20
        if left <= row < left + PADDLE:
            cells[0] = "|"
        if right <= row < right + PADDLE:
            cells[19] = "|"
        if row == ball_row:
            cells[ball_col] = "O"
        print("".join(cells))
    print(scores[0], scores[1])
    print("---")
stages.check_script:
PADDLE = 3
LOWEST_TOP = 20 - PADDLE
MAX_SPEED = 4
TICK_LIMIT = 400
SERVE_FIRST = 5
SERVE_LAST = 14
EVENTS = {"wall", "paddle", "miss"}


def paddle_top(game, rows, column, side):
    cells = [index for index, row in enumerate(rows) if row[column] == "|"]
    game.check(
        len(cells) == PADDLE and cells[-1] - cells[0] == PADDLE - 1,
        f"The {side} paddle must be 3 | characters stacked in column {column}.",
    )
    return cells[0]


def read_frame(game, keys):
    lines = game.tick(keys).rows
    rows = lines[:20]
    game.check(
        len(lines) == 21 and all(len(row) == 20 for row in rows),
        "Each frame must be 20 rows of 20 characters, then the score line.",
    )
    game.check(
        all(cell in ".O|" for row in rows for cell in row),
        "The board may only use ., O, and |.",
    )
    game.check(
        all("|" not in row[1:19] for row in rows),
        "Paddles must stay in column 0 and column 19.",
    )
    balls = [
        (row_index, column)
        for row_index, row in enumerate(rows)
        for column, cell in enumerate(row)
        if cell == "O"
    ]
    game.check(
        len(balls) == 1 and 0 < balls[0][1] < 19,
        "The board must show exactly one ball (O), never in a paddle column.",
    )
    score = lines[20].split()
    game.check(
        len(score) == 2 and all(part.isdecimal() for part in score),
        "The last line must be the score: two whole numbers, like 0 0.",
    )
    return {
        "left": paddle_top(game, rows, 0, "left"),
        "right": paddle_top(game, rows, 19, "right"),
        "ball": balls[0],
        "score": (int(score[0]), int(score[1])),
    }


def moved(top, step):
    return min(LOWEST_TOP, max(0, top + step))


def steer(top, target):
    return (top < target) - (top > target)


def next_row(row, velocity):
    if velocity is None:
        return row
    step = velocity[0]
    if not 0 <= row + step <= 19:
        step = -step
    return row + step


def choose_keys(state, velocity, want_bounce):
    aim = next_row(state["ball"][0], velocity)
    if want_bounce:
        target = moved(aim - 1, 0)
    else:
        target = 0 if aim >= 10 else LOWEST_TOP
    left_step = steer(state["left"], target)
    right_step = steer(state["right"], target)
    keys = {-1: "q", 0: "", 1: "a"}[left_step]
    keys += {-1: "p", 0: "", 1: "l"}[right_step]
    return keys, left_step, right_step


def check_point(game, old, new):
    old_left, old_right = old["score"]
    new_left, new_right = new["score"]
    game.check(
        new_left >= old_left
        and new_right >= old_right
        and new_left + new_right == old_left + old_right + 1,
        "A miss must add exactly one point to one side.",
    )
    game.check(
        SERVE_FIRST <= new["ball"][1] <= SERVE_LAST,
        "After a miss, the ball must be served from columns 5 to 14.",
    )


def learn(game, old, new, speed):
    (old_row, old_col), (new_row, new_col) = old["ball"], new["ball"]
    if new["score"] != old["score"]:
        check_point(game, old, new)
        return None, speed
    game.check(
        abs(new_row - old_row) == 1,
        "The ball must move exactly one row up or down every tick.",
    )
    step = new_col - old_col
    if speed is None:
        game.check(
            1 <= abs(step) <= MAX_SPEED,
            "The ball must move 1 to 4 columns left or right every tick.",
        )
        speed = abs(step)
    game.check(
        abs(step) == speed,
        "The ball must move the same number of columns every tick.",
    )
    return (new_row - old_row, step), speed


def judge(game, old, new, velocity, speed, seen):
    if velocity is None:
        return learn(game, old, new, speed)
    (old_row, old_col), ball = old["ball"], new["ball"]
    row_step, col_step = velocity
    row = old_row + row_step
    if not 0 <= row <= 19:
        row_step = -row_step
        row = old_row + row_step
        seen.add("wall")
    column = old_col + col_step
    if 0 < column < 19:
        game.check(
            new["score"] == old["score"],
            "The score may only change when a paddle misses the ball.",
        )
    else:
        side = "left" if column <= 0 else "right"
        top = new[side]
        if not top <= row < top + PADDLE:
            check_point(game, old, new)
            game.check(
                new["score"][1 if side == "left" else 0]
                > old["score"][1 if side == "left" else 0],
                f"When the ball gets past the {side} paddle, "
                "the other side must score.",
            )
            seen.add("miss")
            return None, speed
        game.check(
            new["score"] == old["score"],
            f"The ball must bounce off the {side} paddle when it covers "
            "the ball's row.",
        )
        col_step = -col_step
        column = old_col + col_step
        seen.add("paddle")
    game.check(
        ball[0] == row,
        "The ball must move one row per tick and turn around at the top "
        "and bottom walls.",
    )
    game.check(
        ball[1] == column,
        "The ball must move its column speed every tick and turn around "
        "at a paddle that covers it.",
    )
    return (row_step, col_step), speed


def check(game):
    state = read_frame(game, "")
    # The first frame is already one tick in, so one point may be scored.
    game.check(sum(state["score"]) <= 1, "The score must start at 0 0.")
    velocity = None
    speed = None
    seen = set()
    for _ in range(TICK_LIMIT):
        if seen == EVENTS:
            return
        # Rally (paddles on the ball) unless a miss is the only thing
        # left to see; rallies carry the ball to the walls.
        dodge = "paddle" in seen and "miss" not in seen
        keys, left_step, right_step = choose_keys(state, velocity, not dodge)
        new = read_frame(game, keys)
        game.check(
            new["left"] == moved(state["left"], left_step)
            and new["right"] == moved(state["right"], right_step),
            "Each paddle must move one row per key press and stop at the "
            "edge.",
        )
        velocity, speed = judge(game, state, new, velocity, speed, seen)
        state = new
    game.fail(
        f"Within {TICK_LIMIT} ticks the ball must bounce off a wall, "
        "bounce off a paddle, and score a miss."
    )
